units.source_text: 五公主会见槿姬时，常常劝她：“

en.t: Whenever the Fifth Princess met Princess Asagao, she often urged her, "

units.source_text: 这位大臣如此诚恳，你还疑心什么呢？

en.t: This minister is so sincere; what more could you possibly doubt?

units.source_text: 他爱慕你，不是今天才开始的。

en.t: His love for you did not begin only today.

units.source_text: 你爸爸在世之日，因为你当了斋院，不能和他结婚，常常愁叹呢。

en.t: While your father was alive, he often lamented that because you had become the Kamo priestess, you could not marry him.

units.source_text: 他说：‘我打定了主意，这孩子偏偏不听。’

en.t: He would say, 'I had made up my mind, but this child simply would not listen.'

units.source_text: 每次说这话时，都很伤心。

en.t: Each time he said this, he was deeply saddened.

units.source_text: 从前左大臣家的葵姬在世之时，我恐得罪三姐，不曾向你劝说。

en.t: In the past, while Lady Aoi of the Minister of the Left's household was still alive, I feared offending my third sister and did not urge you.

units.source_text: 现在呢，这位身份高贵、不可动摇的正夫人已经亡故了。

en.t: Now, however, that noble and firmly established principal wife has already passed away.

units.source_text: 据我看来，由你起而代之，再得当不过了。

en.t: As I see it, nothing could be more fitting than for you to take her place.

units.source_text: 况且源氏大臣也回复了从前的样子，诚恳地向你求婚。

en.t: Besides, Minister Genji has returned to his former self and is sincerely asking for your hand.

units.source_text: 我觉得这真是天作之合了。”

en.t: To me, this truly seems like a match made in heaven."

units.source_text: 她说的一套古老之话，槿姬听了很不高兴，答道：“

en.t: Princess Asagao was displeased to hear this string of old-fashioned remarks, and replied, "

units.source_text: 父亲在日，我一向倔强，直到他逝世没有改变。

en.t: While my father was alive, I remained stubborn, and I did not change even up to his death.

units.source_text: 现在反而回心转意，与人结婚，这真是太荒唐了！”

en.t: For me to change my mind now and marry someone would be utterly absurd!"

units.source_text: 她的样子很难为情，五公主也就不勉强劝说了。

en.t: She looked very embarrassed, so the Fifth Princess did not press her further.

units.source_text: 槿姬看见这宫邸内上下人等都袒护源氏，便觉今后非当心不可。

en.t: Seeing that everyone high and low in the residence sided with Genji, Princess Asagao felt that she would have to be careful from then on.

units.source_text: 至于源氏本人呢，一味尽忠竭诚，静待槿姬回心转意，却并不无理强求而伤害她的心情。

en.t: As for Genji himself, he devoted himself with complete sincerity and quietly waited for Princess Asagao to change her mind, without forcing her unreasonably or hurting her feelings.
